title: seseli iliense
intro: Seseli iliense, commonly known as Balkan dragon or Balkan dragon carrot, is a perennial plant species belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of Seseli iliense include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-arthritic, anti-spasmodic, and anti-histaminic effects. The plant's bioactive compounds contribute to its potential therapeutic applications in treating various conditions, making it a subject of interest in modern pharmacology and medicine.
